In the spirit of knowledge sharing, we’re passing along some of our favorite lessons on design and development. Beyond how to operationalize craft, facilitate handoff, or craft copy, these practical guides teach us that there’s always more to learn.

## [10 rules for craft](#_10-rules-for-craft)

Gone are the days of “move fast and break things.” In today’s design-conscious market, standing out means committing to quality and craft. That’s certainly been the M.O. at software development platform Linear, where Karri Saarinen is Co-founder and CEO. Ahead of his [keynote talk at Config](https://config.figma.com/san-francisco/session/99c03fe0-dfa5-458f-9703-4c0d9615cbd4/), we asked Karri how his company cultivates craft at every level.

## [A guide to handoff](#a-guide-to-handoff)

How well designers and developers collaborate is make or break for product teams—but going from design to build can put their motivations and skills at odds. To bridge the gap, we put together a tactical guide to handoff, focusing on three principles: fostering curiosity, opening up communication, and aligning on what “good” looks like.

[![An illustration shows hikers navigating a forested mountain by reading trailmarkers.](data:image/png;base64,)![An illustration shows hikers navigating a forested mountain by reading trailmarkers.](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/f885c3d4bbdcf636dd5449e2148c8e2b35d25e72-1260x730.png?w=528&h=306&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/blog/the-designers-handbook-for-developer-handoff/)

## [Why writing matters](#why-writing-matters)

To be good product builders, we need to be good storytellers. Whether it’s describing technical architecture, presenting new features, or pitching product roadmaps, success often depends on clearly articulating a vision. We outline how to bring that vision to life through the written word.

[![A handwritten serif text with blue outlines and red fill reads, “Why everyone can (and should) be a great storyteller!” ](data:image/png;base64,)![A handwritten serif text with blue outlines and red fill reads, “Why everyone can (and should) be a great storyteller!” ](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/079effb6ac4761d3fc3143e2043c77f44c79d5cf-1260x730.png?w=528&h=306&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/blog/why-everyone-can-and-should-be-a-great-storyteller/)

[**Read more**](https://www.figma.com/blog/why-everyone-can-and-should-be-a-great-storyteller/)

## [Build for the long term](#build-for-the-long-term)

With AI tools advancing at breakneck speed, designers and product builders aren’t just concerned with making things work—they’re focused on making things work _well_. In this conversation with Y Combinator’s Garry Tan, Figma Co-founder and CEO Dylan Field explains why play and experimentation are crucial to the product development process, and shares his advice for founders today.

## [Rabbit hole](#rabbit-hole)

![Alt text: 1) abstract pixelated orange, green, and blue shapes 2) a mobile phone showing the New York Times app with 2024 Election Day coverage 3) three concentric circles portray a business’s growing market share](data:image/png;base64,)![Alt text: 1) abstract pixelated orange, green, and blue shapes 2) a mobile phone showing the New York Times app with 2024 Election Day coverage 3) three concentric circles portray a business’s growing market share](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/9cb7bbce491007ecde49d5209b188bca0e8fcdc1-1296x726.png?rect=0,1,1296,725&w=804&h=450&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

1\. [“Vibe coding” has entered the chat](https://www.figma.com/blog/double-click-vibe-coding/)

. Here’s why some developers are embracing the new wave of building software—and why others are leaving it on read.

2\. What does it take to “[design at the speed of the news](https://www.figma.com/blog/in-good-company-how-publishers-use-figma-to-help-design-the-news/)

”? _The New York Times_, _The Economist_, and _The Minnesota Star Tribune_ give us the scoop on how they use Figma to collaborate.

3\. Teams are using Figma Slides to power client presentations, product roadmaps, fundraising, and beyond. [Take a slide out of their book](https://www.figma.com/blog/how-teams-tap-into-the-power-of-design-with-figma-slides/)

by tapping into new features and [community templates](https://www.figma.com/community/file/1479866880691206473).
